title: Stained Glass Inferno
description: A crumbling stone archway with a vibrant stained glass window stands on the left, while a massive, glowing explosion of fiery orange, yellow, and red circular forms billows upward into a dark, stormy sky on the right. The rocky ground is littered with stones and debris under a deep blue twilight atmosphere.
prompt: A surreal night scene featuring an ancient crumbling stone arch with a colorful stained glass window on the left side of the frame. To the right, a massive turbulent explosion of glowing circular orbs in fiery orange, yellow, red, and dark purple rises into a dramatic stormy sky with deep blue and grey clouds. Rocky debris covers the foreground ground. Moody cinematic lighting, painterly texture, atmospheric and surreal.
